# Studio

> Make talking clips, short video, stills, and lip-sync for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Pick Seedance, Grok, Veo, or Nano Banana.

Studio is a chat-first tool for finished short-form files. Pick a face, write the line, choose a model, and download the clip. Free and paid plans come with monthly credits, and packs cover a busy month. Create a free account to start. It does not post anything for you.

- [Home](https://example.com/): Composer preview and example gallery
- [About](https://example.com/about): Who it is for, how it works, FAQ
